name: oh-my-codex
description: Multi-agent orchestration layer for OpenAI Codex CLI

interface.shortDescription: Workflow layer and skill bundle for OpenAI Codex CLI.
interface.longDescription: Plugin = OMX skill/workflow discovery plus plugin-scoped companion metadata for hooks, MCP servers, and apps. Setup = runtime wiring and native agent TOMLs in both modes. Legacy setup also installs prompt/skill copies; plugin setup enables official plugin-scoped hooks, archives legacy prompt copies, removes only stale generated/non-installable native agents, and preserves user-authored or ambiguous roles during normal setup. Scoped setup also maintains config, optional AGENTS.md, HUD, and runtime state.
